notes: InfiniBand characterization spans the SerDes lanes (eye, CDR, de-skew), Link-Layer credits/VL arbitration/VCRC, and Transport-Layer PSN reliability. Interoperability is established by IBTA Plugfest / Integrators' List testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Per-lane data eye
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the differential serial eye at the target rate (SDR 2.5 .. NDR 100 Gbps/lane), NRZ or PAM4.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Link training
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm Down->Polling->Configuration->LinkUp at each width/speed and lane de-skew.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: BER / CRC
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure bit-error rate; confirm VCRC (per hop) and ICRC (end-to-end) detect injected errors.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Credit-based flow control
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate per-VL absolute credit accounting and self-correction.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: VL arbitration
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm SL-to-VL mapping and weighted round-robin (high/low priority + Limit-of-High).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Reliable delivery
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject loss; confirm PSN-based ACK/NAK and retransmission.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RDMA latency / bandwidth
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Characterize end-to-end RDMA READ/WRITE latency and throughput at each width/speed.
